overview.description: The GraniteShares YieldBoost HIMS ETF (HMYY) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in health care equity. The fund is actively managed seeking current income and the daily 2x leverage of the price performance of Hims & Hers Health, Inc. (NASDAQ: HIMS) HMYY was launched on Dec 2, 2025 and is issued by GraniteShares.
